body: Round 1 (1d72f169..9dc5c565), P2 high: dirname ran through the inherited PATH before the env -i re-exec (lines 21 and 24), so a decoy dirname could redirect root and with it pre_send.py and the checker; the reviewer reproduced a decoy dirname running. Fixed in b8a5c394 (the one correction round): /usr/bin/dirname for both; nothing else runs from PATH before the re-exec (cd, pwd, [[ and echo are builtins).

Round 1, P2 high: test_entrypoint_fixed_environment's decoys (uv, python3, bash, env, mise) omitted dirname, so the test was vacuous for the one PATH lookup left. Fixed in b8a5c394: dirname joins the decoys; the subtest is red at 9dc5c565 ((0, '') != (1, '')) and green at b8a5c394.
Round 1, P3 medium: test_temp_failure_is_redacted accepted any ': refused' line. Fixed in b8a5c394: it asserts 'tempfile: refused'.

Round 1, P3 medium: GRAMMAR and the output test's label strip accepted any [a-z-]+ label. Fixed in b8a5c394: LABELS names the set (consistency, secret-pattern, literal-home, self-cap, bash-syntax, owner-section, input, tempfile, interpreter, startup), used by both.

Round 1, P3 low: a YAML error is reported on the consistency label with its marks rather than its own label, and only task_id is read from the mapping. Kept: the preserved a02 test test_checker_exit_and_line_numbers_only requires 'consistency: refused line(s) 6,7' for a YAML error, and the 28 tests stay unchanged; kind, security and allowed_files are validated by the checker, whose exit status the consistency label carries, and no pre_send check consumes them. Reported as advisory for the owner dotfiles-T133-pre-send-check-followup-a01.

Round 2 (a30a43ba..3c663e05), P2 high: ITEM matched only a bare `## Item <n>`, so titled `## Item 1: ...` / `## Items 2-3: ...` headings stopped counting and an empty owner section with several Items was falsely refused. Fixed in 7e4f8ddd (`## Items? \d+\b`, still excluding `## Itemized`); subcase red at 5297bec0, green at 7e4f8ddd.

Round 2, P3 high: `---` after a bullet is a thematic break, yet it ended the owner section. Fixed in 7e4f8ddd: only a paragraph (non-blank, not a bullet or ATX line) takes a setext underline; subcase red at 5297bec0, green at 7e4f8ddd.
Round 2, P3 medium: a multi-line setext title subtracted only its last row. Fixed in 7e4f8ddd: every row of the open paragraph is subtracted; subcase red at 5297bec0, green at 7e4f8ddd.

Round 2, P3 medium, kept: UV_CACHE_DIR is checked with -d only, so an explicit value naming the shared default cache passes. The task refuses only unset or non-directory values and forbids a fallback, which the entrypoint never makes; recorded as a report residual.
